english: Place beside an end of the step deck, not on a step. You can register a second panel at the other end. Wire at least one to a generator or battery. Hold E for Start/Stop, Forward/Reverse, and Run Always or only when something is on it. Register it with the Escalator Setup Tool.
Not part of any escalator. Hold the Escalator Setup Tool, aim here, hold E, Register Panel.
Hold it, aim at a half-block step, hold E. New Escalator, Set End 1 and Set End 2 on opposite corners of the step deck, Register Panel. Side pieces and walls stay put. A rubber rail is added on them.
Craft the Escalator Setup Tool. Aim at a half-block step and hold E. New Escalator, Set End 1 and Set End 2 on opposite corners of the step deck only, then Register Panel.

You build the steps. Half-blocks only. Any width: mark opposite corners of the whole deck. Walkway: all the same height, at least 3 long. Escalator: two flats, then one half-step up each block, then two flats at the top. Leave the block under every step empty. Landings go outside the ends, as wide as the stairs.
Hold E on a registered Escalator Panel for Start/Stop, Forward/Reverse, and Run Always or only when something is on it. A tap of E does nothing.
Place the Escalator Panel beside an end, not on a step. Wire it to a generator or battery. Register it with the setup tool. The belt only runs when that panel is powered.
Stand on the moving steps and they carry you. At either end you step onto the landing. Anything on the belt rides — players, zombies, loot. Leave two blocks of air above the treads.

Curved newel for either end. Place it beside the first or last step, outside the deck, at that step's block height. Rotate so the curve points off the end and the glass faces the steps. Left and Right are mirrors. Use the Upper piece when that step is the top half of the block. The rubber rail moves with the belt.
Same curved end, shifted up half a block. Use it when the step beside it is the top half of the block. Rotate so the curve points off the end and the glass faces the steps.

One metre of the sloped side. Place it beside each rising step, same block height as that step, outside the deck. Rotate so it climbs uphill and the glass faces the steps. Left and Right are mirrors. Use Upper when that step is the top half of the block.
Same slope piece, shifted up half a block. Use it beside a rising step that is the top half of the block.
Level side for a walkway, or the flat steps at each end. Place it beside the step, outside the deck. Rotate so the glass faces the steps. Use Upper when that step is the top half of the block.
Same level side, shifted up half a block. Use it when the step beside it is the top half of the block.

Place Escalator End, Slope, and Flat pieces beside the steps, not on them. Left and Right are mirrors — rotate so the glass faces the steps. A solid wall with no piece still gets a rubber rail. The rail moves with the belt.
